purpose: Prerequisites for executing all 67 APIs against an isolated test environment.

mysql: DATABASE_URL points to an isolated test database
Prisma schema is synchronized, including users.password_hash nullable for Google users
redis: Reachable Redis instance for OTP state, rate limits and refresh-token revocation
smtp: Working SMTP credentials and a mailbox/inbox accessible to the tester for registration, password-reset, invitation and mention flows
azureBlob: Valid Azure Storage configuration and a writable blob container for task attachments and avatars
google: Google OAuth client allows http://localhost:3000 as an authorized JavaScript origin
A fresh Google ID token from an account not yet registered, or adjusted existing-Google-user login logic

requiredSeedData: Project roles PROJECT_MANAGER, PROJECT_MEMBER, ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN.
Task statuses OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, REVIEW and DONE with stable IDs expected by ChangeTaskStatusDto.
At least three users: project manager/owner, active project member and non-member.
An ACTIVE project, checklist and tasks covering pending and DONE states.
A second project/member relationship for 403 authorization checks.
A tag, comment, notification, attachment and invitation token for dependent CRUD/download/acceptance tests.
credentialsAndInputs: Bearer access tokens for each seeded user.
OTP values obtained from the configured test inbox.
A safe sample file below 20 MB for attachments and a JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP image below 5 MB for avatar tests.
testSafety: Use a disposable database, Redis namespace, mailbox and Azure container because tests create, update, soft-delete and hard-delete records.
Do not put real JWTs, Google ID tokens, passwords, SMTP credentials or Azure connection strings into response fixtures or version control.
Run destructive endpoint cases last, or reseed the environment before each suite.
